parsed.summary: Wallet Maintenance for Ethereum Network (ETH) - 2026-10-28 Binance will perform wallet maintenance for Ethereum Network (ETH) at 2026-10-28 06:00 (UTC). To support the wallet maintenance, deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum Network (ETH) will be suspended starting from 2026-10-28 05:55 (UTC), and be resumed when the maintenance is complete. The maintenance will take about one hour. 👉🏻 Learn more here
